title: Kett Alderhook
kicker: a desperate field leader trying to seize leverage from the carriage
hook: a desperate field leader trying to seize leverage from the carriage

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: A horned Bramble field leader stands in moss-dark armor, jaw set, a blue ward pendant burning at the chest like a borrowed badge of command.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: Carries the whole camp's survival like a debt he co-signed. Hard-jawed in front of the scouts, unsure the moment they look away. Believes the road stole from his people first, and is terrified of becoming the exact villain the company already wrote him as.

blocks.label: Might Offer
blocks.body: Parley path Capture/mercy branch Evidence that the road conflict is bigger than banditry
